```{r}
# Create a sample variable containing students' marks
marks <- c(60, 70, 80, 85, 90, 75, 65, 95, 100, 80)

# Display the variable
print(marks)

# a function that calculates mean
calculate_mean <- function(x) {
  mean(x)
}
# a function to calculate median
calculate_median <- function(x) {
  median(x)
}

# a function to calculate minimum value
calculate_min <- function(x) {
  min(x)
}
# a function to calculate maximum value
calculate_max <- function(x) {
  max(x)
}
# Create a function to calculate standard deviation
calculate_sd <- function(x) {
  sd(x)
}
# Apply functions to the marks variable
calculate_mean(marks)
calculate_median(marks)
calculate_min(marks)
calculate_max(marks)
calculate_sd(marks)

# Create a function for all summary statistics

summary_stats <- function(x) {

  results <- c(
    Mean = mean(x),
    Median = median(x),
    Minimum = min(x),
    Maximum = max(x),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(x)
  )

  return(results)
}

# Apply the function to marks
summary_stats(marks)
summary_stats <- function(x) {
  get_mode <- function(v) {
    t <- table(v)
    as.numeric(names(t)[t == max(t)])
  }

  results <- list(
    N = length(x),
    Mean = mean(x),
    Median = median(x),
    Mode = get_mode(x),
    Minimum = min(x),
    Maximum = max(x),
    Range = diff(range(x)),
    Q1 = unname(quantile(x, 0.25)),
    Q3 = unname(quantile(x, 0.75)),
    IQR = IQR(x),
    Variance = var(x),
    Standard_Deviation = sd(x),
    CV_percent = sd(x) / mean(x) * 100
  )

  return(results)
}

summary_stats(marks)


```
